basic_info.description: Beautiful, never before sold 4 bedroom, 3 bath full floor condo in one of the only classical, three story buildings on Russian Hill's iconic flat block of Chestnut Street. The bay views are unobstructed with Alcatraz and the Bay front and center. Staging and photos are from the top floor condo (1052 Chestnut), actual unit furniture and details differ from photos. Layout is nearly identical to 1052 Chestnut. Situated directly above the newly developed Francisco Park, these are among the best views in San Francisco. Meticulously maintained with elegant details throughout the unit, from the magnificent living room, formal dining room, built in bar area and chef's kitchen with high end appliances including Viking Range and Bosch. The classic and refined style continues with the Master Bedroom, accompanying powder room and granite tiled bathroom. Three of the bedrooms come with en suite bathrooms. Details throughout from custom woodwork on doors to rose bronze door knobs to generous storage throughout.
